info.name: FantasyZone API
info.description: Run the folders in order with the Collection Runner. Set adminPassword to your backend ADMIN_PASSWORD. Test users are created automatically with unique emails.

exec: pm.test("Field errors listed", function () { pm.expect(json.fieldErrors && json.fieldErrors.email !== undefined).to.be.true; });

item.name: Get player stats with fantasy points

exec: pm.test("Fantasy points calculated by the app", function () { pm.expect(json[0].fantasyPoints > 0).to.be.true; });

item.name: My leagues shows join code to commissioner

exec: pm.test("Join code visible", function () { pm.expect(json[0].joinCode !== undefined).to.be.true; });

item.name: Same player on another team in league (409)
Roster history shows add, drop, add (newest first)

exec: pm.test("One matchup for two teams", function () { pm.expect(json.length === 1).to.be.true; });
pm.test("Week 1 has a matchup", function () { pm.expect(json.length === 1).to.be.true; });
pm.test("Alice leads with a win", function () { pm.expect(json[0].teamName === 'Alice FC' && json[0].wins === 1).to.be.true; });
pm.test("Bob has a loss", function () { pm.expect(json[1].losses === 1).to.be.true; });
